runtime_choices.B12X_W4A8_TINY_DECODE: 0 (tiny decode omits swiglu_limit; see experiment README)
runtime_choices.B12X_AUTOTUNE: 0 (autotune race budget is free memory // 2 on unified memory)
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens (the drafter's trained block), draft TP 3, adaptive verification cost scale 2, dead verification rows below survival 0.2, block rejection; greedy drafts vocabulary-parallel (vLLM patch 0012) over an NVFP4 Markov projection with an NVFP4 drafter head, and a column-sharded drafter main_proj (0013)
runtime_choices.cudagraph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1-48 (adds 40 and 48 for eight streams at 1 + 5 rows)
runtime_choices.flashinfer_autotune: disabled (--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune): it saved 0 configs, and only the sampler uses FlashInfer
runtime_choices.engram_projection: sharded across ranks (projection_tp, padded to 25632 rows by vLLM patch 0001)
runtime_choices.engram_rows: read beside the forward launch (SPARK3_ENGRAM_ASYNC=1, vLLM patch 0002 re-ported); the base's Engram overlap is off (VLLM_DS41_ENGRAM_OVERLAP=0)
runtime_choices.multimodal: vision tower loaded (no --language-model-only), up to 4 images per request; --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 (vLLM's default 4 GiB host cache would come out of dgx1's guard margin)
runtime_choices.host_sysctl: vm.watermark_boost_factor=0 on every node (/etc/sysctl.d/90-watermark-boost.conf): a watermark boost hides up to 0.87 GiB from MemAvailable, which the memory guards read
runtime_choices.l2_prefetch: on (the base's default on SM121): side-stream L2 prefetch of the next decode projections
runtime_choices.nccl: 2.30.7 rebuilt with patches/nccl (NVIDIA/nccl#2393 IB send-path fence) in place of the base image's wheel
runtime_choices.chat_template_defaults: none: thinking is the default when a request names neither key, so a client's enable_thinking=false is honored
runtime_choices.prefill: sequence-parallel once a forward's reduce-scatter exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce (205 tokens at TP 3; vLLM patches 0014-0018, no setting): per-layer all-reduces become reduce-scatters, row-wise work runs on a third of the rows, CED encoder layers only
runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument

change_from_previous: Prefill sequence parallelism without a setting (vLLM patch 0018): a forward runs sequence-parallel when it is prompt processing and its padded hidden-state message exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce's 2 MiB, 205 tokens at TP 3, where the reduce-scatter really scatters; below that SP only added two all-gathers per layer. And a host-overhead fix (patch 0019): torch's custom-op fill_defaults read the schema once per argument, costing B12X's 64-argument MoE launch about 0.8 ms of host time per layer on short prefills; it now reads it once.

evidence.summary: third-round screen against two pooled controls: prefill TTFT -11.2% on a 73-token prompt, -4.0% to -6.3% at 1-2K tokens, unchanged at 4K; decode within noise; LRU 5/5 on every run. A tiny-prompt profile found the forward host-bound (74 of 236 ms GPU idle, 59 ms inside the MoE launch). Reference run on this configuration: LRU 5/5, lowest dgx1 MemAvailable 6.59 GiB under load
